TABLE.NAME: tool_mergeusers
TABLE.COMMENT: List of merged users: data from fromuserid user is merged into touserid user.

FIELD.NAME: touserid
FIELD.COMMENT: User that will remain with data of both users.

FIELD.NAME: fromuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: Data from this user.id will be merged into the touserid.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Time stamp when the merging action took place.

FIELD.NAME: log
FIELD.COMMENT: List of actions performed if success, or errors on merging failure.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Status of the merge: pending, inprogress, success, error. NULL for legacy logs.

INDEX.NAME: mdl_toolmerg_sta_ix
INDEX.COMMENT: Index for filtering by merge status.
